description: Counts the reactions most often named in reports to the FDA (CAERS) about a food, drink, dietary supplement or cosmetic brand, for example "CELSIUS", most frequent first. Helps people asking about energy drinks, supplements and protein powders see what has been reported, with the caveat that reports are unverified. Source: FDA CFSAN Adverse Event Reporting System via openFDA. Counts are of reports mentioning each reaction, not proven side effects or rates, and small brands may have few or no reports. (cost: 1 credit)

brand.description: string, required, brand or product name as reported, e.g. "CELSIUS"

limit.description: integer, optional, 1-50, number of reactions to return, default 20

name: fda_supplement_reactions
